title: Velvety Canadian Bread Skillet
description: A one-pot dish featuring white bread, deglazed onions, and a rich peppery sauce, perfect for a low-sodium-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 10 minutes.
Add bread to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly toasted, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, butter, pepper, thyme, paprika, and salt. Stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is almost completely absorbed, about 5 minutes.
Transfer skillet to the oven and bake, uncovered, at 375°F (190°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the edges are crispy.
Remove from oven and serve hot.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
